question: Were patients who already had the outcome at the prediction time excluded?
Is every feature computed only from data recorded up to the prediction time?
Are length of stay, discharge information and other end-of-stay fields excluded from the predictors?
Was resampling (for example SMOTE) applied inside the training set only, with the test set left untouched?
Are diagnosis and billing codes taken only from earlier admissions, not the admission being predicted?
Was the decision threshold chosen without the test set?
Were hyperparameters and the final model chosen without the test set?
Was feature selection performed on the training set only?
Are severity scores used only when their measurement window ends by the prediction time?
Were imputation, scaling and other preprocessing fitted on the training set only?
Is every feature restricted to results available (stored or verified) by the prediction time, not only charted before it?
Are infusions, ventilation and other interval records still running at the prediction time truncated or prorated?
Were training and test sets split by patient, so that no patient contributes stays to both?
If validation is called temporal, is it ordered by true calendar time (in MIMIC-IV, anchor_year_group), not shifted dates?
If validation is called external, does the external set share no hospitals or patients with the development data (MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV overlap in 2008 to 2012)?
Are outcome fields and scores computed with the outcome (for example recorded hospital mortality) excluded from the predictors?
Are code status, care limitation and end-of-life documentation restricted to entries made before the prediction time?
